checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals the directory, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 07-lifecycle-messaging.

checks.description: The hub routes to all five sub-skills and does not write copy or send itself.
checks.rule: Body references segmentation-logic, nonpayer-email-flow, onboarding-sequence, event-sequence, and winback-flow with a routing rule.

checks.description: The hub selects the sequence pattern by the brief's audience and objective via a selector, and points to the sequence-standards library.
checks.rule: Body has a selector mapping audience and objective to a pattern (welcome, onboarding, event, non-payer, winback) and references templates/sequence-standards.md as the standards every pattern follows.

checks.description: The hub assembles the lifecycle-package with the exact body fields from handoff-contract.md.
checks.rule: Output names flow, audience_size, send_on_approval, suppression wrapped in the common envelope.

checks.description: The flow references QA-passed copy variants by id; it never writes copy.
checks.rule: Body states each message references a QA-passed copy variant by id and the hub does not write copy.

checks.description: The platform is an open item; design proceeds but the package is not-sendable until confirmed.
checks.rule: Body marks the platform open item and marks the lifecycle-package not-sendable until the platform is confirmed and approved.

checks.description: Suppression excludes paying contacts, unsubscribes, and hard bounces, and is stated explicitly.
checks.rule: Body states suppression is not optional and no paying contact, unsubscribe, or hard bounce receives a flow.

checks.description: The hub states the gate stack in order then the human gate for the send.
checks.rule: Body lists skill eval, arabic-copy-qa, brand-qa-reviewer, then human gate for the send, per verification.md.

checks.description: The hub never invents the offer, price, schedule, Skill Path title, or instructor name.
checks.rule: Body instructs reading the offer, price, and schedule from the brief and stopping when absent, and forbids invented titles or instructor names.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash character, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals.
